services.title: What I can build for you
services.intro: Contract engagements, scoped to what you actually need. I work solo end-to-end or plug into your team.

items.name: Full-stack web apps
items.body: React/TypeScript front ends with Node, Express, or FastAPI back ends and Supabase, Postgres, or Firebase behind them. Auth, dashboards, admin tools, exports.

items.name: iOS & mobile apps
items.body: React Native / Expo and native Swift. On-device features, StoreKit in-app purchases, and App Store submission, start to finish.

items.name: Payments integration
items.body: Square, Stripe, and Apple StoreKit: checkout, subscriptions, one-time unlocks, and the back-office pieces around them.

items.name: AI automation & agents
items.body: Practical AI that does work: automated social, outbound, phone calls, documentation, and review. I run around 50 coordinated agents across my own businesses and can build the same for yours.

items.name: Brand, music & media
items.body: I design the brand, write the copy, produce the music, and make the content. Useful when you want one person to carry a product and its story together.

items.name: Static sites & hosting
items.body: Fast, data-driven static sites (Astro, Vite) deployed to shared hosting like Hostinger, with the content in one file you can edit yourself.

steps.name: Tell me the problem
steps.body: Email a short description of what you want built or fixed, and your deadline if you have one.

steps.name: Scope & quote
steps.body: I come back with a plan, a timeline, and a fixed-scope quote or an hourly estimate.

steps.name: Build with check-ins
steps.body: I build in the open with regular updates, so you see progress and can steer it.

steps.name: Ship & hand off
steps.body: You get the working product, the source, and clear docs so your team can run it.

work.title: Selected work
work.intro: A slice of what I've built. Status is labeled honestly: Live, In App Store review, Repo (source published), or Prototype.
work.statusLegendNote: Do not relabel any project as 'Live' unless it has a working public URL.

projects.name: PassOkay
projects.oneLiner: Passport, visa, and ID photo app that checks your photo against the spec, entirely on your device.
projects.detail: You take or pick a photo, crop it to a document size, and get on-device checks for face, head size, centering, eyes, expression, tilt, lighting, and background. The photo never leaves the phone. A watermarked preview is free; one photo unlocks in HD for $4.99. The iPhone app uses React Native (Expo SDK 55) with native Swift Vision for the checks and StoreKit for the purchase. There's also a web version.

projects.name: AwkBeats
projects.oneLiner: Beat marketplace with lease tiers, sample packs, and booked sessions, built around Square checkout.
projects.detail: An online store for my own beats and a producer brand (Awkward J). Lease tiers, presets, sample packs, and booked sessions, with Square checkout and a download library. React/TypeScript front end, Express API, Supabase data. An iOS beat-store companion app is in progress.

projects.name: Autonomous AI operation (~50 agents)
projects.oneLiner: Around 50 purpose-built AI agents that run my brands, outreach, phone calls, documentation, and code review.
projects.detail: I run a coordinated set of roughly 50 AI agents that operate my businesses: social accounts across Instagram, X, YouTube, and TikTok; outbound prospecting; automated phone calls; project documentation; branding; knowledge bases; and code review, with an overseer agent watching the rest. It's a working example of practical AI automation and agent orchestration, and I can build the same pattern for a company.

projects.name: Loaded Sound Management
projects.oneLiner: Artist-management site with paid consultations, intake, bookings, and an admin back office.
projects.detail: A site for an independent artist-management business: public pages plus a back office for intake, bookings, CSV exports, and admin. Paid consultations run through Square. Built with Astro for the static side and a Node server for the dynamic parts.

projects.name: Darkjuan Logic Games (Coolbeanman)
projects.oneLiner: Free browser brain games for ages 10–16, with progress saved in the browser and optional donations.
projects.detail: A set of free logic and brain games aimed at kids and teens. Built as a Vite 6 + React 19 + TypeScript single-page app, with a small PHP endpoint for donations through Square and progress stored in the browser. Hosted on Hostinger.

projects.name: Restoration Fellowship Church
projects.oneLiner: Public church site plus a staff dashboard for events, outreach, photos, and prayer and guest lists.
projects.detail: A public site and a private staff dashboard. Staff manage events, outreach, photos, guest and prayer lists, and finance records. Built with Vite, React, TypeScript, and Supabase.

projects.name: AwkBeats Prep Station
projects.oneLiner: Offline desktop catalog that imports beats, measures BPM and key on the machine, and writes the tags back into the audio files.
projects.detail: A desktop app for preparing a beat catalog before it goes to the store. It imports WAV, MP3, AIFF, and FLAC files or whole folders, detects tempo and musical key locally, picks up cover art that sits next to each file, and writes the metadata back into the audio. Nothing is uploaded; the library is a JSON file in the app-data folder. Built with Electron, React, and TypeScript, with installers published through GitHub Actions releases.

projects.name: Loaded Valet Trash
projects.oneLiner: Website and owner-only operations backend for a doorstep valet-trash service for apartment communities in Valdosta.
projects.detail: The public site explains the service to residents and leasing offices. Behind it is an owner and porter back office for properties, routes, and pickups. PHP 8 with MySQL, PHPUnit tests, and CI on GitHub, hosted on Hostinger.

projects.name: HandyHearts Care Tech
projects.oneLiner: Tech-help service for older adults: book a consultation or service without an account, with a separate staff side.
projects.detail: Visitors request a consultation or book a service without signing up; staff sign in on a separate internal path. Web front end with a Node API, Supabase staff auth, Stripe for quoted bookings, and an iOS app in the same repo.

projects.name: Victory Independent Living
projects.oneLiner: Housing intake and partner recruitment web app for a Valdosta independent-living program.
projects.detail: Tenant applications and partner sign-ups with UTM tracking, plus contact and resources pages, as a static build ready for Hostinger. Vite, React, and TypeScript, with optional Gemini-powered local insights. Form endpoints are still being connected.

projects.name: PhotoVirtue
projects.oneLiner: Telegram bot plus browser and desktop photo editors, with a one-time Bitcoin payment for a year of access.
projects.detail: A Python project with three entry points: a Telegram bot for paid access, a FastAPI and Pillow browser editor, and a Tkinter desktop editor. Early codebase; payment and deploy wiring are still in progress.

projects.name: Restaurant demo sites (x9)
projects.oneLiner: Nine static restaurant sites driven by one JSON file per page, with an in-browser cart.
projects.detail: A set of nine static restaurant sites built from a shared template, each page driven by its own JSON file, with a browser-side cart. A good example of data-driven templating at volume, where content is editable without touching the layout.

projects.name: CLUTCH
projects.oneLiner: Hyper-local on-call labor marketplace for Valdosta: an iOS app and a web app on a shared backend.
projects.detail: A marketplace that connects people who need short-notice local labor with people who want the work. Built as an Expo / React Native iOS app and a Vite + React web app sharing a Firebase backend.

projects.name: damage-report & damage-report-loop
projects.oneLiner: Published developer tools for Cursor Agent: evidence-based PR status reports and bounded fix-test loops.
projects.detail: Two open-source developer tools I published. damage-report generates evidence-based status reports for pull requests and git worktrees; damage-report-loop runs bounded audit-fix-test loops against GitHub pull requests. They reflect how I work: verify against evidence, review carefully, and keep changes bounded.

projects.name: The Couch Is Dirty (podcast platform)
projects.oneLiner: Self-hosted podcast platform with Postgres auth and roles, plus an iOS app.
projects.detail: A self-hosted podcast platform with Postgres-backed authentication, role-based access, and Docker deployment, alongside a native iOS app in Swift and a web version. Shows backend and devops range, not just front-end work.

projects.name: Convertible Mortgage Calculator
projects.oneLiner: Real-time mortgage comparison with convertible-ARM scenarios and a printable amortization schedule.
projects.detail: A focused calculator that models convertible adjustable-rate mortgage scenarios in real time and prints a clean amortization schedule. A small, self-contained piece of front-end engineering.

projects.name: SayThisRapThat
projects.oneLiner: AI-assisted rap and trap songwriting with phonetic analysis and song structure.
projects.detail: A songwriting tool that uses phonetic analysis to help with rhyme and flow and lays out song structure. Built in Python with Docker. A crossover of my music and engineering sides.

projects.name: FormFlow DB
projects.oneLiner: Database-driven PDF autofill: a FastAPI service with a Next.js front end.
projects.detail: A tool that fills PDF forms from stored data, built as a Python/FastAPI API with a Next.js web app, containerized with Docker.

projects.name: AI image tools (Coverly, BustDown, PeelPix)
projects.oneLiner: Three image apps built on generative models: mixtape covers, style transforms, and a plain-language photo editor.
projects.detail: A small family of AI image apps. Coverly generates mixtape cover art, BustDown turns a photo into viral-style edits, and PeelPix edits and restores photos from natural-language instructions. All built with Vite, React, and TypeScript on Gemini image models.

projects.name: Vibe Virtue
projects.oneLiner: My consulting umbrella: a live consulting site plus a tech-consulting app for local businesses.
projects.detail: Vibe Virtue is the umbrella for my independent work. It includes a live consulting site and a tech-consulting app and knowledge base for local businesses. Vibe Virtue Enterprise LLC is also planning educational and adventure games for PlayStation 5; that work is in the planning stage.
